verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a data-pipeline/CDP platform, not an AI agent or orchestrator that consumes external tools; the evidence consistently shows Jitsu exposing its own MCP server for AI agents to call INTO (jitsu-docs-19, jitsu-docs-46, jitsu-docs-63), not Jitsu acting as an MCP client that plugs in and uses other servers' tools. This story's direction (product-as-client) is a category mismatch for a backend data-integration platform.
